title: Fix Nx Configs After Folder Restructure
description: The folder layout has massively changed and was structured. Make sure all configs and imports are updated so everything runs with Nx. Initial failures observed from `bunx nx run-many -t build --all --nxBail`: `@semio-tech/compose-rs:build-wasm` fails on Windows with `spawn C:\WINDOWS\system32\cmd.exe ENOENT` from `bun scripts/build-wasm.mjs`, and `@elements/ui:build` Storybook fails to resolve `@semio-tech/coda-desktop/renderer` from `elements/ui/.storybook/stories/OntologyTree.stories.tsx`. Work end-to-end until Nx is green or remaining blockers are validated and isolated.
summary: Canonicalized active Nx target names across the monorepo to verb-style targets. Renamed specialized targets like build-mcp-app, test-integration, setup-playwright, test-quick, package, build-gh/build-yak, and build-wasm into canonical build/test/setup/publish/dev/start flows or removed redundant custom targets. Folded Grasshopper build steps into a single build target, folded dependency-cruiser into workspace lint, renamed workspace inspector entrypoints to dev/start, removed unused coordinator worker/migrate targets, updated all downstream references and bootstrap scripts, and moved Rust/WASM build inputs into the canonical @semio-tech/compose-rs build target. Validation: active project.json inventory contains none of the old noncanonical target names; bun nx run @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad:setup succeeded; renamed publish/build/test targets resolve through Nx. Remaining command failures are pre-existing project issues unrelated to the rename (for example missing coda assistant import path, repo vscode test import path, repo client go.work test context, and existing compose/js/react test fixture/import failures).
